summary: Comprehensive testing of Italian Desserts (DolceVita) website - all core features working. 18/18 backend tests passed. Frontend flows (homepage, menu, cart, checkout, contact, admin) all functional.

integration_issues.issue: Navigating directly to /admin/products via page.goto() redirects to login (auth context resets on full page reload). Works correctly via React Router sidebar navigation. Root cause: /auth/me API call on page load may fail due to cookie not being sent - needs investigation on cookie domain/secure settings.

issues: Some product images are not relevant to the dessert shown: 'Pistachio Bomboloni' shows macarons, 'Lemon Curd Bomboloni' shows colorful donuts, 'Mixed Berry Bomboloni' shows a cupcake. Unsplash URLs in seed data need to be updated to more appropriate images.

action_items: Fix product image URLs in seed data to use more relevant dessert images (pistachio bomboloni showing macarons, etc.)

Investigate admin auth persistence on full page reload - cookie secure/samesite settings may cause issues in production HTTPS environment (currently set secure=False which may need to be True for HTTPS)
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie set with secure=False - on HTTPS production, cookies should have secure=True to follow best practices
AdminOrders.js has eslint warning: useEffect missing 'load' dependency
CORS configured with '*' via env var - should be restricted to specific frontend domain in production
seed_admin() only inserts admin if not exists, but updates password if changed - good idempotent behavior

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all major flows working, minor image relevance issue)

seed_data_creation: 3 test orders and 2 contact messages created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 18 backend API tests pass. Frontend fully functional: homepage hero/products/reviews, menu with category filtering, add-to-cart, checkout COD flow with order confirmation, contact form, admin login/dashboard/products/orders/messages all working. The only issues are minor: some product images not matching product descriptions, and cookie secure=False on HTTPS production. Razorpay is not configured (by design) and correctly returns 'not configured' when called.
